source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the C3A4 and C3N4 builds of the core-ar2 0.3 unit test, recorded in rytm2_mods velocity-humanise/README.md at afd461d
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, 2026-10-20: in C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports) velocity-humanise 1.1's test steps 1 to 3 pass: on the TRIG page FUNC + VEL reads RND with a 0..64 popup; with N = 32 a track of equal-velocity trigs varies in level, with N = 0 it does not; N is kept through save, power-cycle and reload, and through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT. In C3N4 (C3A4 without euclid-accents) step 4 passes: steps 1 to 3 behave the same, and euclid on/off is unaffected by N.
scope: velocity-humanise 1.1 beside other rytm2_mods ports (with and without euclid-accents), never alone. No build with the released core-ar2 0.3 has run on a unit with it yet.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: N is kept through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT.

builds.label: C3N4
builds.content: C3A4 without euclid-accents: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153 and ten of rytm2_mods v1.2's OS 1.74 release objects, this module's included.
results: Step 4: steps 1 to 3 behave the same without euclid-accents, and euclid on/off is unaffected by N.

individualTestResults: N = 32 varies the hits; N = 0 does not
N kept through save, power-cycle and reload
Same without euclid-accents; euclid unaffected by N

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. Modwerk links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153), which differs from C3A4's core.
